# Junction Industries, LLC
> Veteran-owned industrial, infrastructure, and technology holding company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas.

Junction Industries acquires, operates, and scales market-leading industrial businesses across North America, focusing on heavy engineering, fabrication, and material handling.

## Operating Subsidiaries
- Trident Structures: EPC contractor specializing in turnkey dry bulk material handling systems, concrete batch plants, rail transload terminals, and storage silos. URL: https://www.trident-structures.com/
- Harbor Fab: Heavy industrial and structural steel fabrication, specialized pressure vessels, and AWS D1.1 certified welding.
- Advanced Intralogistics: Industrial conveyor systems, warehouse automation, palletizing solutions, and freight distribution engineering.
- Pier 57: Marine construction, commercial waterfront infrastructure, floating dock systems, and marine steel fabrication.
- Grey Oaks Property Management: Industrial asset management, commercial facility maintenance, and strategic infrastructure leasing.
- Palo 32 / Halyard Technologies: Industrial SCADA controls, automation software, and IoT infrastructure systems.
